$comment: MOCK example config for one client. Copy to client.config.json (gitignored) and fill per client. NON-SECRET only — no API keys, no tokens (those live in n8n Credentials / Vercel env). Validated against ../schemas/client.config.schema.json.

bot.$comment: LLM pricing (llmPricePer1kTokensIn/Out) lives HERE in config, not in code — if the provider changes prices, update these two lines only. llmCostCapUsd is the hard MONTHLY spend brake; over it the bot stops calling the LLM and hands off.

messageTemplates.askService: Which service would you like? (Haircut / Beard Trim / Haircut + Beard)
messageTemplates.askDateTime: What day and time works for you?
messageTemplates.handoff: I'm passing you to a team member — we'll get back to you shortly.
messageTemplates.handoffLocked: A team member is already helping you here — they'll reply shortly.
messageTemplates.leadCaptured: Thanks! We've got your details and someone from the team will reach out soon.
messageTemplates.faqUnknown: Good question — let me check with the team and get back to you on that.
messageTemplates.slotJustTaken: Sorry — that time was just taken. A team member will help you find another slot.
messageTemplates.bookingNeedsConfirm: Thanks! We're confirming your booking now — a team member will follow up shortly to finalize it.
messageTemplates.verifyIncomplete: We couldn't finish confirming that time just now — a team member will follow up to lock it in.
messageTemplates.cancelNoBooking: You don't have an active booking to cancel.
messageTemplates.cancelCutoff: That booking is too close to its time to cancel here — please call us and we'll sort it out.
messageTemplates.cancelUnavailable: I couldn't reach the calendar to cancel just now — a team member will follow up shortly.
messageTemplates.cancelNeedsHuman: I found your booking but can't cancel it automatically — a team member will cancel it for you.
messageTemplates.cancelAlreadyDone: That booking is already cancelled — nothing more to do.
messageTemplates.cancelTargetGone: I couldn't find that booking to cancel anymore — a team member will follow up shortly.
messageTemplates.notUnderstood: Sorry — I didn't catch that. Could you rephrase?
messageTemplates.rescheduleNoBooking: You don't have a booking to reschedule.
messageTemplates.rescheduleCutoff: That booking is too close to its time to reschedule here — please call us and we'll sort it out.
messageTemplates.rescheduleNeedsHuman: I found your booking but can't reschedule it automatically — a team member will help you move it.
messageTemplates.rescheduleAskSlot: Sure — what new day and time would you like to move it to?
messageTemplates.rescheduleAborted: No problem — your booking stays as it is.
messageTemplates.rescheduleInsertFailed: Sorry — I couldn't move your booking; your original appointment still stands. A team member will follow up.
messageTemplates.rescheduleMirrorFailed: Your booking change is being finalized — a team member will confirm the new time shortly.
messageTemplates.reminder: Reminder: your {service} is booked for {when}. See you soon!

faq.address: We're at Musterstrasse 12, 1010 Vienna — 2 minutes from Stephansplatz U-Bahn.
faq.parking: Street parking is available on Musterstrasse; there's also a paid garage 100m away on Beispielgasse.
faq.walkin: Walk-ins are welcome whenever a chair is free, but booking ahead guarantees your slot.
